title: Zucchini Bread with Chocolate Chips
description: This zucchini bread with chocolate chips recipe yields two loaves studded with chocolate chips — vegetable oil, zucchini, and sour cream add moistness.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease two 9x5-inch loaf pans.
Whisk flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and baking soda together in a large bowl; set aside.

Beat sugar, oil, and eggs together in a separate large bowl with an electric mixer until well combined; fold in zucchini and sour cream. Stir in flour mixture until well combined; fold in chocolate chips. Divide batter between the prepared pans.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean, 40 to 60 minutes. Cool in the pans on a wire rack for 20 minutes.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make chocolate chip zucchini bread. This baking recipe combines grated zucchini with a sweet batter to make a moist and delicious bread. After beating sugar, vegetable oil, and eggs until combined, add in the grated zucchini with sour cream to create the base of the batter. Incorporate the dry mixture into the batter and add chocolate chips. Bake for over an hour and allow the bread to cool. The rich flavor and crusty texture will make this a go-to bread recipe!
